settlementProof.claim: A complete machine-work settlement executed on Arc mainnet: a payer escrowed USDC, an evaluator attested a result, and USDC was released only after BOTH signatures validated.

honestNotes: This is a founder-funded demo with 0.5 USDC of the founder's own money. No third-party or user funds have ever touched the contract.

The demo ran on the ES module `cast` path rather than `forge script --broadcast` because Arc's native USDC calls a system precompile (0x1800...0001::isBlocklisted) inside transferFrom; the Arc node handles it natively, but forge's local revm simulation cannot and therefore refuses to broadcast. See docs/arc-integration-notes.md.

The contract owner (0x92bF...) is a demo key whose private key was shared during this session and must be treated as compromised. A production deployment must use a fresh owner key; owner powers are limited to rotating the default evaluator and pausing new job creation, and can never touch an existing job's funds.
The evaluator and the provider are the same address in this demo. In production they are distinct roles.
The amount is a demo amount (0.5 USDC); this is evidence that the path works, not a claim about volume.
